<entry id="T00908">
<head-word>רָעַם</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. רעד)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>to vibrate</italic>,] 
<italic>to thunder, rumble, roar</italic>.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִרְעִים</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> same. Ab. d’R. N.
<language-key> ch. </language-key>XXXIII ed. Schechter same.</definition>
<notes> Ab. d’R. N. ch. XXXIII ed. Schechter מצרים הִרְעִימוּ עליהם בקולם אף הקב"ה ה' עליהם קולו the Egyptians roared at (threatened) them with their voices, so did the Lord cause his voice to roar at them (II Sam. XXII, 14); (oth. ed. ה' עליהם בקול על הים, ref. to Job XXXVII, 5). Midr. Sam. ch. V אם עולים … אני מַרְעִים בקולי וכ' if they rise up to heaven, from there I will thunder with my voice and throw them down; Yalk. Sam. 86; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cause to thunder</italic>, v. supra.</definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cause to murmur</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. 77 (ref. to הרעמה, I Sam. I, 6) את מַרְעֶמֶת אותה וכ' thou makest her ‘thunder’ against me, … there are no thunders which are not followed by (fructifying) rain, I will visit her at once; Pesik. R. s. 43 מְתַרְעֶמֶת (fr. תִּרְעֵם). Ib. בעבור הַרְעִימָהּ על אלהים לטובתה in order to make her murmur against God (complain in prayer) for her own good.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְרָעֵם</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> (v. (v. תַּרְעוּמֶת) 
<italic>to be excited, rebel, be discontented</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Meg. 6
<sup>a</sup> זבולון מִתְרַעֵם על מדותיו היה Zebulun was dissatisfied with the measures he received (the share of the land allotted to him).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be disturbed, get into commotion</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pesik. R. s. 11 כולם מִתְרַעֲמִים ומרגישים all the nuts in the pile are disturbed and in commotion; Yalk. Cant. 992.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<sense>

<italic>to be in commotion, troubled</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ez. XXVII, 35 [prob. to be read:] אִתְרְעִימוּ (ed. אתרשימו, h. text רעמו).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="T00911">
<head-word>רַעַם</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> רָעַם)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>thunder</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 12 beg. (ref. to Job XXVI, 14) הר' הזה כשהוא יוצא כתיקונו וכ' no human being 
<pgbrk id="pg1488" />could stand the thunder coming forth as it is prepared (in its full strength); ib. סדרו של ר' the arrangement (nature) of the thunder; Yalk. Job 914; a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. רְעָמִים</plural-form>. Ber. IX, 1. Ib. 59
<sup>a</sup>, v. עַקְמוּמִית. Ḥull. 86
<sup>a</sup>. Pesik. R. s. 43; Yalk. Sam. 77, v. רָעַם; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="T00913">
<head-word>רַעֲנָן</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="T00889"> cmp. רְעִי II)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>moist, green, fresh</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Midr. Till. to Ps. XCII בצרתם הם כזית ר' even when they are in distress, they are like a green olive tree (hopeful); Pirké d’R. El. ch. XIX; Yalk. Ps. 845. Midr. Till. to Ps. XVIII, 30 ברוש אחד ר' a green cypress tree; a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. רַעֲנַנִּים</plural-form>. Yalk. Jer. 296 אף העלים … היו ר' וכ' even the leaves which dropped from him (Abraham) were green, that is Ishmael.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="T00914">
<head-word>רָעַע</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) [
<italic>to bring in close contact</italic>, v. 
<xref rid="T00670">רֵיעַ</xref>,] </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to strike against, shatter, impair.</italic></definition>
<notes>
<italic>—Part. pass</italic>. רָעוּעַ; f. רְעוּעָה; 
<plural-form>pl. רְעוּעִים, רְעוּעִין; רְעוּעוֹת</plural-form>
<italic>impaired, defective; in a ruinous state, threatening</italic>, opp. בריא sound. Kidd. 39
<sup>b</sup> סולם ר' a broken ladder. Kel. III, 5 הר' a cracked vessel. Taan. 20
<sup>b</sup> מפולת שאמרו בריאות ולא ר' the falling of houses which they mention (ib. III, 4) means the falling of sound buildings, but not of such as were out of repair; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (neut. verb) רַע, imperf.</definition>
<notes> יֵרַע 
<italic>to be injurious, evil</italic>; רע ל־ 
<italic>to grieve, displease</italic>. B. Mets. 84
<sup>b</sup> בני אל ירע לך my son, let it not grieve thee; a. e.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>רֵעַע</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to shatter, break</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—Part. pass. מְרוֹעָע; f. מְרוֹעַעַת; 
<plural-form>pl. מְרוֹעָעִים, מְרוֹעָעִין; מְרוֹעָעוֹת</plural-form>. Koh. R. to III, 2 השרוי בבית המר' he who dwells in a threatening house; Y. Sabb. II, 5
<sup>b</sup> top מְרוֹעֲרַע (fr. רִעְרֵעַ). Gen. R. s. 32 קנקנים מר', v. קַנְקָן I. Y. Taan. III, 66
<sup>d</sup> top מְרוֹעֲרָעִים threatening buildings; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְרָעֵעַ, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִתְרָעֵעַ, </binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>Hithpol</italic>.</definition>
<notes> הִתְרוֹעֵעַ, 
<italic>Nithpol</italic>. נִתְרוֹעֵעַ 
<italic>to be shaken, cracked, become defective</italic>. Men. 53
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Jer. XI, 16) מקול מיליהן … נִיתְרָעֲעוּ דליותיהן וכ' from the sound of the words of the spies were the branches (young men) of Israel broken; Yalk. Jer. 289 נרתעו (read: נִתְרָעוּ). Sot. 48
<sup>a</sup> (play on ערה, Zeph. II, 14) אפי' בית … מִתְרוֹעֵעַ even a house which lies in a thicket of cedars will be shaken; Yalk. Is. 292 מתנועע (corr. acc.). Y. Snh. X, 27
<sup>d</sup> bot. לכיפה … כיון שנִתְרוֹעֲעָה אחת מהן נִתְרוֹעֲעוּ כולן like a heap of stones, when one of them is shaken (disturbed), all of them are shaken; Y. M. Kat. III, 83
<sup>c</sup> שנִתְרַעְרְעָה … נִתְרַעְרְעוּ (fr. רערע); Gen. R. s. 100 וכולה מִתְרוֹעַעַת; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הֵרַע</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to shake, impair</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Shebi. X, 39
<sup>d</sup> top מֵירַע כוחן it impairs their prerogatives; ib. מוֹרַע (fr. יָרַע). Y. Pes. VII, 34
<sup>d</sup> top שהוֹרַעְתָּ כחו וכ' whose standing thou declarest impaired in the case of an ascertained uncleanness. Ex. R. s. 8 הֵרֵעוּ לנפשם they did harm to themselves; a. e.—V. הֲרָעָה.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be evil</italic>; ה' ל־ 
<italic>to displease</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tanḥ. Sh’laḥ 5; Num. R. s. 16
<sup>7</sup> וה' לאביו and it displeased his father; a. e.—[</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to join, combine</italic>, v. 
<xref rid="T00881">רָעָה</xref>
<italic>Pi.</italic>]</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hof.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הוּרַע</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, or הוֹרַע (fr. יָרַע) 
<italic>to be shaken, impaired</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Kidd. 20
<sup>b</sup>, sq. ה' כחו his prerogative is impaired, v. יָפֶה. B. Kam. 44
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="T00915">
<head-word>רְעַע</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>to shatter, break</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Jud. IX, 53 ורָעַת (Levita ורְעִיעַת; some ed. ורעתת, corr. acc.). Targ. Y. II Ex. XV, 6 רָעָא (some ed. רעע, corr. acc.). Targ. Job XX, 19 (ed. Wil. רָעַע 
<italic>Pa.</italic>); a. e.—Part. pass. רְעִיעַ, רְעִיעָא; f. רְעִיעָא, רְעִיעֲתָא. Targ. Is. XLII, 3. Targ. Koh. XII, 6; a. e.—Taan. 20
<sup>b</sup> אשיתא ר' Ms. M. (ed. רעועה h.) a threatening wall. Ib. ביתא ר' a ruinous-looking house; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>רָעַע</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> same. Targ. Job XX, 10. Ib. 19, v. supra; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Af.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אֵרַע</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to do harm</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. XXIV, 21 מֵרַע (Ms. מְיָירַע; h. text רֹעֶה).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִיתְרַע</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be shaken, broken; be afraid</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Deut. XX, 3 (Var. תִּתְיָרְע').</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be shaken, impaired</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Hor. 12
<sup>a</sup> ומִיתְרַע מזליה and his luck may be shaken, v. רִיעַ II. B. Bath. 59
<sup>a</sup> דתִיתְרַע וכ', v. אֲשִׁיתָא. Ḥull. 10
<sup>a</sup> סכין אִיתְרְעָאִי וכ' the status of the knife has been impaired (the knife having been found notched after slaughtering), but the status of the slaughtered animal (the presumption of its ritual fitness) has not been shaken, v. רֵיעוּתָא.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="T00916">
<head-word>רַעַף</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<plural-form>pl. רְעָפִים, רְעָפִין</plural-form> (רעף, cmp. רצף, 
<italic>to press, flatten</italic>) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>flints</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Ber. VIII, 12
<sup>b</sup> bot. זימן לו הקב"ה שני ר' וכ' the Lord made him (Adam) find two flints which he struck against each other and produced fire; Gen. R. s. 11; s. 12; s. 82. Bets. IV, 7 (33
<sup>a</sup>) אין מוציאין את האור … ולא מן הר' Bab. ed. (absent in Mish. a. Y. ed.) you must not produce fire (on the Holy Day) from wood … or from flints.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>glazed tiles</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. אין … את הר', v. לָבַן II. Men. V, 9 מאפה ר' what is baked on hot tiles; Tosef. ib. VII, 20 עשאן … ובר' if he baked them in a brazier or on tiles; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="T00917">
<head-word>רָעַץ</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.,</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="T00914"> cmp. רָעַע</xref>,
<xref rid="A00083"> רָצַץ)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to break, shatter</italic>.</definition>

<entry id="T00919">
<head-word>רַעַץ</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (preced.) [
<italic>rugged</italic>,] 
<italic>Raʿats</italic>, the form of 
<italic>the Samaritan type</italic>, opp. אַשּׁוּרִית, q. v. Y. Meg. I, 71
<sup>b</sup> bot. בר' ניתנה התורה the Torah was given in Raʿats characters.</definition>
<notes> Ib. אשורית … נהפך להן לר' וכ' the Torah was given them in Asshurith, but when they sinned, it was changed for them into Raʿats, and when they improved in Ezra’s days, it was changed &c.; Snh. 22
<sup>a</sup> לרועץ (Ms. F. לרעוץ, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 200); Tosef. ib. IV, 7 לרועץ; Yalk. Ezra 1069 לרועץ. Y. Meg. I, 71

<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Esth. III, 1) אחר … ר' למכה after the Lord had prepared the remedy for the wound (the means of delivery from the affliction). Ib. אין הקב"ה … ר' תחילה the Lord does not strike Israel, unless he has prepared the remedy in advance. Sabb. VI, 10 משום ר' as a medicinal amulet. Ib. 67
<sup>a</sup> כל דבר שיש בו משום ר' whatever is done for medicinal purposes. Ib. מאי ר' קעביד what remedy can he effect by it? Ber. 60
<sup>a</sup> (a prayer before blood-letting) יהי רצון … לר' ותרפאני … ורְפוּאָתְךָ אמת may it be thy will, O Lord my God, that this procedure be a cure to me, and heal thou me, for thou art a faithfully healing God, and thy healing is real; a. fr.—רְפוּאַת ממון, רפואת נפש, v. רִיפּוּי.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>R’fuah, prayer for health</italic>, name of the eighth section of the Prayer of Benedictions (תפלה).</definition>
<notes> Meg. 17
<sup>b</sup> לימא ר' בתרה דתשובה why not recite R’fuah immediately after T’shubah (prayer for forgiveness)? Ib. ומה … ר' בשמינית what reason had they to make R’fuah the eighth benediction? Ib. (ref. to Is. l. c.) ההוא לאו ר' … אלא ר' דסליחה this is not healing referring to diseases, but a healing (from sin) through forgiveness; a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. רְפוּאוֹת</plural-form>. Pes. IV, 9 (56
<sup>a</sup>) גנז ספר ר' he suppressed a book of remedies (charms and incantations). Y. R. Hash. I, 57
<sup>b</sup> נרתיק של ר' a medicine chest. Y. Ber. V, 9
<sup>b</sup> top; Y. Taan. I, 63
<sup>d</sup> top; a. fr.—Yoma 86
<sup>a</sup> גדולה … ר' לעולם (some ed. רִפְאוּת; Ms. O. רְפוּאָה, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 80) repentance is a great thing, for it brings healing (delivery) to the world; Yalk. Jer. 269 רפואה.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<xref rid="A00083"> רָצָה)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>desire, will, good-will</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 27 כשאהיה אני עליהם אתה הוי בר' … אני בר' when I am angry with them, be thou in a conciliatory mood; and when thou art angry, I will be conciliatory, v. רָצָה. Ab. II, 4 עשה רְצוֹנוֹ כרְצוֹנְךָ וכ' do his (God’s) will as being thy will, in order that he may do thy desire as being his own; בטל רצונך וכ', v. בָּטֵל I. Tosef. Ber. III, 7 עשה רצונך וכ' do thou thy will in the heavens above; Ber. 29
<sup>b</sup>; a. v. fr.—יהי ר' (abbrev. יה"ר) be it the will (of God), v. רַעֲוָא. Ib. 28
<sup>b</sup>. Taan. 5
<sup>b</sup>, sq.; a. v. fr.—יהי ר' מלפניך (abbrev. יר"מ) be it thy will. Ber. 60
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—בר' 
<italic>willingly</italic>, opp. באונס. Keth. 9
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—לר' 
<italic>a</italic>)
<italic> acceptable</italic>. Sifra Vayikra, N’dab., ch. III, Par. 3 (ref. to Lev. I, 3) כשם שאם אינו תמים אינו לר' וכ' as a sacrifice is not acceptable when it is not perfect &c.; a. e.—
<italic>b</italic>) 
<italic>intentionally</italic>. Makhsh. VI, 8 מטמא לר' ושלא לר' makes susceptible of uncleanness whether it is discharged intentionally (by milking) or unintentionally (by spontaneous dripping); ib. המשקין … לר' the liquids which come out of them with man’s intention (by pressing); Sabb. 143
<sup>b</sup>, sq.; a. fr.—
<italic>c</italic>) 
<italic>welcome</italic>. Makhsh. I, 1 כל משקה שתחלתו לר' וכ' a liquid the contact with which is welcome at first (e.g. rain washing utensils), though finally it may be unwelcome (injurious).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<number>1)</number>
<definition> [
<italic>flattened</italic>, cmp. רָצַם,] (
<italic>leather</italic>) 
<italic>thong, strap, lash</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. V, 4 בר' שבין קרניה with the strap between her horns. Men. 35
<sup>b</sup> ר' דתפלין the thong of the T’fillin. Num. R. s. 16 לתינוק שסרח ולקה בר' … מזכירין לו הר' וכ' like a child that did some mischief and was punished with a strap, and when they want to frighten it, they mention the strap with which it was punished; כך היה עמלק ר' רעה וכ' so was Amalek the bad lash for Israel; Tanḥ. Ḥuck. 18 מעולם רְצוּעַת מרדות וכ' (not רצועה) Amalek was at all times the strap of chastisement for Israel. Macc. III, 12 (22
<sup>b</sup>) ור' בידו של וכ' and he (the beadle) held in his hand a lash of calf-skin, which was twisted doubly, and two (thinner) straps were going up and down (were plaited) through it (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 7). Y. Sot. IX, 24
<sup>b</sup> top בעל הר' the strap-bearer, v. רַצְעָן. Yoma 12
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. ור' היתה יוצאה מחלקו וכ' a strip of land went forth from Judah’s lot and entered into Benjamin’s territory, and on this the Temple was built; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. רְצוּעוֹת</plural-form>. Macc. l. c. ושתי ר' (not ושני), v. supra. Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXVII עשר ר' אתה לוקה thou art to receive ten lashes. Sabb. VI, 1; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (trnsf.) 
<italic>restriction</italic>; הותרה הר' [the strap is untied,] the restriction is removed.</definition>
<notes> Koh. R. to XI, 9 (ref. to שמח וכ', ib.) הותרה הר' לית דין וכ' is every restraint removed? is there no justice and no judge?; ib. to I, 3; Lev. R. s. 28, beg.; a. e.—Y. Bicc. I, 64
<sup>a</sup>; Y. Kidd. IV, 66
<sup>b</sup> top הואיל והותרה הר' יכ' since the restriction has been removed (by usage), I am likewise permitted to marry her. Y. Sot. VII, end, 22
<sup>a</sup>; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sense>

<italic>to perforate</italic>, cmp. הרג; חָלָל,] 
<italic>to slay, murder</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Midr. Till. to Ps. III (ref. to ארבעתים, II Sam. XII, 6) אתה רָצַחְתָּ אחד שש עשרה נִרְצָחִים יהיו לך thou hast murdered one: there shall be sixteen of thine murdered; Yalk. Sam. 148. Macc. 12
<sup>a</sup> מי כתיב אם ר' it reads not (Num. XXXV, 27), ‘if he slew’ (but, ‘he shall slay’); ib. מי כתיב יִרְצַח it reads not, ‘he shall slay’ (but, if he slays he is not punished); a. e.—Part. רֹוצֵחַ 
<italic>manslayer, murderer</italic>. Shebi. X, 8; Macc. II, 8 ר' שגלה … ר' אני when an involuntary manslayer comes to his place of refuge, and the citizens desire to honor him, he must say, I am a manslayer. Snh. 73
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Deut. XXII, 26) מקיש ר' … אף ר' ניתן להצילו בנפשו the text draws an analogy between the case of one pursued by a murderer and that of the betrothed woman threatened with assault: as it is permitted to save the woman at the cost of the assailant’s life, so it is permitted to save the pursued at the cost of the would-be murderer’s life; Pes. 25
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.—[Tosef. Sot. XV, 7, read: רֹוצְעָן.]—
<plural-form>Pl. רֹוצְחִים, רֹוצְחִין</plural-form>. Macc. 10
<sup>a</sup>, v. זָרַח. Ib. 9
<sup>b</sup> בגלעד שכיחי ר' in Gilead cases of manslaughter are frequent; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>

<entry id="T00981">
<head-word>רצי</head-word>
<head-word>רָצָה</head-word>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> v. 
<xref rid="unknown">רְעֵי II</xref>) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to favor, pardon</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Midr. Till. to Ps. XLIV אף בניו … ולהם רָצִיתָ ולא לנו thou hast also done great things for his (Abraham’s) children in the desert, and to them thou hast been benevolent, but not to us. Sifra Vayikra, N’dab., Par. 3, ch. IV (ref. to Lev. I, 4) המקום רוֹצֶה לו the Lord will receive his offering with favor (pardon him); ועל מה המקום רוצה וכ' and for what sins will the Lord pardon him? For sins of omission &c.; Yalk. Lev. 438. Ab. V, 11 נוח לִרְצוֹת easily appeased; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to please, desire, be willing, consent</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Lev. R. s. 34 רְצֵה והחליצנו, v. חָלַץ. Meg. 29
<sup>a</sup> (play on תר̇צ̇ד̇וןֹ, Ps. LXVIII, 17) למה תִרְ֗צ̇וּ ד̇ין̇ עם סיני why do you desire a contest with Sinai?; Yalk. Jud. 47 למה אתם ר̇ו̇צִ֗ים ומד̇יינ̇ים why are you so willing to contest? Macc. 10
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. בדרך שאדם רוצה וכ' on what way a man wants to go, they (heavenly powers) lead him. Keth. 12
<sup>b</sup> אם רָצוּ לעשות וכ' if they wish to follow the usage of priests &c. Yeb. IV, 5 לא ר' if he declines (to act as 
<italic>yabam</italic>). Ab. Zar. 32
<sup>a</sup> רוצה בקיומו ע"י דבר אחר if he wants the preservation of an idolatrous object for some other purpose. Ber. 7
<sup>a</sup> כשרָצִיתִי לא רָצִיתָ וכ' when I was willing (to reveal myself), thou wast unwilling (didst hide thy face) &c.; a. v. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>רִצָּה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to appease, to procure pardon</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ex. R. s. 45 יהיו פני מְרַצִּין את פניך my countenance shall appease thy countenance, v. כָּעַס. Ib. כשהיה … הקב"ה מְרַצֶּה אותו וכ' when Moses was angry with Israel, the Lord appeased him &c. Ib. אהיה מְרַצְּךָ I shall appease thee; (Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 27 אני ברצון, v. רָצוֹן). Ab. IV, 18 אל תְּרַצֶּה וכ', v. כַּעַס. Ber. l. c. מנין שאין מְרַצִּין וכ' whence do we learn that we must not attempt to appease a man at the moment of his excitement? Sifra l. c. אע"פ שלא סמך הזבח מרצה although he has not put his hand on the victim, the sacrifice produces pardon; Yalk. Lev. l. c. נרצה הזבח the sacrifice is accepted. Pes. 16
<sup>b</sup> על מה הציץ מרצה for what (mistake at sacrifices) does the high priest’s plate effect pardon (make the sacrifice acceptable)?; Men. 25
<sup>b</sup>. Ib. III, 3. Sifré Deut. 32 כשם שקרבנות מְרַצִּים וכ' as sacrifices are the means of atonement, so are sufferings &c.; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>

<italic>to make pleasing, acceptable</italic>.</definition>

LXXXV הקב"ה … עד שתְּרַצֶּה מעשיה להקב"ה the Lord turns around and observes and puts his eye on her (the earth), until she makes her deeds pleasing unto the Lord; ib. אותה שעה היא מְרַצָּה וכ' then she makes her deeds pleasing &c.; Yalk. ib. 833.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be acceptable, be accepted</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sifra l. c. ונרצה לו לו ולזבחו ‘it shall be accepted for him’ (Lev. I, 4) he and his sacrifice shall be accepted; Yalk. Lev. l. c. Ib. נ' הזבח, v. supra; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>

<senses>

<entry id="T01080">

<senses>
<sense>
<definition>,
<pos> f.</pos> (רָשָׁה) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>power, authority, control</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ned. X. 2, v. רוֹקֵן. Gen. R. s. 67 ששה … ברְשׁוּתוֹ שלשה אינן ברשותו six things (organs) serve man, three of which are under his control, and three are not; העין … ורשותו וכ' the eye, the ear, and the nose are not under his control &c. Bets. V, 2 משום ר' as an exercise of authority (judging, betrothal &c.; differ. interpret. in comment.); a. fr.—Esp. 
<italic>secular government</italic>, (mostly) 
<italic>the Roman government in Palestine, Roman officials, Roman party</italic>. Ab. I, 10, v. יָדַע. Ib. II, 3, v. זָהִיר. Sabb. 11
<sup>a</sup>, v. חָלָל III. Ab. Zar. 17
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Prov. XXX, 15) קול שתי בנות … ומאי נינהי מינות והר' Ms. M. the voice of two daughters that cry from Gehenna, and say in this world, ‘bring, bring’; and who are they? Heresy and Government. Makhsh. II, 5 אם יש בה ר' if it is the residence of Roman officials (for whom the baths are always kept in readiness). Yoma 86
<sup>b</sup> והר' מקברת וכ' and high office buries its occupant (causes premature death). Erub. 41
<sup>b</sup> שלשה אין רואין … חולי מעיין והר' three persons shall not see Gehenna (expiate their sins in this world): those who suffer from extreme poverty, from bowel diseases, and from governmental exactions (Rashi: from 
<italic>creditors</italic>). Y. Snh. VI, 23
<sup>d</sup> sq. ר' של מטן the earthly government; ר' של מעלן the divine government; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. רְשׁוּיוֹת</plural-form>. Ḥag. 15
<sup>a</sup> שמא … שתי ר' הן are there, God forbid! two powers (governing the universe)? Gen. R. s. 1 (ref. to ברא, Gen. I, 1) אין כל … שתי ר' וכ' none can say, two powers created the world (the verb ברא being in the singular) &c. Ber. 33
<sup>b</sup> דמיחזי כשתי ר' (saying מודים twice) has the appearance of a belief in a duality; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (trad. pronunc. רְשׁוּת) 
<italic>dominion, domain, territory</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. I, 2 ר' המיוחדת למזיק a territory exclusively belonging to the owner of the animal that did the damage; ר' הניזק והמזיק a space belonging to both owners. Ib. 13
<sup>b</sup> (in Chald. dict.) תורך ברְשׁוּתִי מאי בעי what had thy ox to do in my ground. Ib. 81
<sup>a</sup>; Taan. 6
<sup>b</sup> שבילי הר' the paths (short cuts) through private property. B. Mets. 5
<sup>b</sup> משביעין אותו שבועה שאינו ברשותו we make him swear that it is not in his possession; a. v. fr.—ר' היחיד (abbrev. רהי֞) 
<italic>private ground</italic>; ר' הרבים (abbrev. רהר֞, רה֞) 
<italic>public road</italic>. Sabb. 6
<sup>a</sup>; a. v. fr.—Ib. 9
<sup>a</sup> הרי זו ר' לעצמה this forms a territory for itself (with regard to Sabbath movements). Ib. VII, 2 המוציא מר' לר' he who carries things (on the Sabbath) from one territory to another; a. fr.—
<italic>Pl.</italic> as ab. Ib. 6
<sup>a</sup> ארבע ר' לשבת וכ' there are four classes of territories with regard to Sabbath laws &c.; Tosef. ib. I, 1. Ib. 6; Sabb. l. c. אסקופה … שתי ר' the threshold stands for two territories; when the door is open, it is classified with the interior &c. Ib. 9
<sup>a</sup> כל … מוצא שתי ר' וכ' wherever you find two territories belonging to the same class; a. fr.—Y. Kidd. III, 64
<sup>c</sup> top; Y. Ned. VIII, 40
<sup>d</sup> bot. (ref. to R. Jose’s opinions Kidd. III, 9, a. Ned. VIII, 2) תמן הוא אמר עד שיצאו כל הרשויות הגדולות עד שיצאו כל הר' הקטנות וכ' there, he says, the terms, ‘the oldest’, ‘the youngest’, tend to exclude all the older daughters, and all the younger daughters respectively (so that only the oldest of the daughters of his first wife, and respectively the youngest of the daughters of his second wife are meant), and here he says so (that the widest scope is adopted)?</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>permission, option; optional act</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 28
<sup>a</sup> וניתנה להם ר' וכ' and permission to enter was given to the students. Ab. III, 15, v. צָפָה. Ḥull. 141
<sup>a</sup> לדבר הר', v. מִצְוָה. Ib. 106
<sup>a</sup>, v. מִצְוָה. Ber. 27
<sup>b</sup>, v. חוֹבָה. M. Kat. III, 3 אגרות של ר', v. שְׁאִילָה; a. fr.—נטילת ר' 
<italic>taking leave of absence, parting</italic>, at which a religious remark was customary. Lev. R. s. 17 עביד להו נ' ר made these verses the text for leave-taking (cmp. אַפְטַרְתָּא). Y. Ber. II, 5
<sup>c</sup> bot. ההיא מילתא … הוה נ' ר' דידיה that remark … was his leave-taking.—[</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>4)</number>
<definition> (cmp. רַשַּׁאי 2) 
<italic>debt, loan, creditor’s claim</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Erub. 41
<sup>b</sup>, v. supra.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>
